title: Feature Maturity Radar
purpose: Visual classification of all 20 business capabilities into Mature (6), Functional (12), and Basic (2) tiers.
audience: Product managers, engineering leads, CTO, investors
description: Feature maturity assessment across three tiers. Mature (green, 6): Identity and Access Management, User Profiles CRUD, Content Feed, Real-Time Messaging, Admin Dashboard, Analytics. Functional (orange, 12): Content Gallery, Tipping, PPV, Content Upload, Subscriptions, Referral System, Support Tickets, Contests, Bulk Upload, AI Captions, Enclave, Platform Settings. Basic (red, 2): Payouts and Earnings (fully mocked), Notifications (DB-only, no push). The gap between Mature and Basic tiers reveals critical investment needs.

modules.label: Identity and Access Management
modules.description: Mature: Register, authenticate, authorize across 3 roles.

modules.label: User Profiles CRUD
modules.description: Mature: Profile CRUD, avatar upload, onboarding, verification, settings.

modules.label: Content Feed browse search
modules.description: Mature: Personalized feed from subscribed creators, paginated.

modules.label: Real-Time Messaging basic text
modules.description: Mature: One-to-one DMs with Socket.IO real-time delivery.

modules.label: Admin Dashboard
modules.description: Mature: Platform administration with dashboard, user management, moderation.

modules.label: Analytics basic event tracking
modules.description: Mature: Event tracking, basic aggregation.

modules.label: Content Gallery
modules.description: Functional: Fan bookmarking with JSONB storage, signed URL thumbnails.

modules.label: Tipping crypto flow works if not mocked
modules.description: Functional: Crypto tipping via sandbox bypass. Stripe endpoints dead 404.

modules.label: PPV same as tipping
modules.description: Functional: PPV uses same crypto verification as tipping.

modules.label: Content Upload with thumbnail gen
modules.description: Functional: Multipart upload with sharp/ffmpeg. Sync thumbnail gen is slow.

modules.label: Subscriptions basic crypto no renewal
modules.description: Functional: Basic crypto sub flow, no renewal or expiry logic.

modules.label: Referral System without payout
modules.description: Functional: Code generation, validation, stats. No actual payout.

modules.label: Support Tickets with DM sync
modules.description: Functional: Ticket CRUD with DM sync for replies.

modules.label: Contests with weighted selection
modules.description: Functional: Weighted and standard winner selection. No audit trail.

modules.label: Bulk Upload
modules.description: Functional: DropZone, DraftCards, sequential publish.

modules.label: AI Captions
modules.description: Functional: AI caption via OpenRouter/OpenAI. Sync HTTP wait 1-5s.

modules.label: Enclave applications only
modules.description: Functional: Enclave application system. No membership management.

modules.label: Platform Settings
modules.description: Functional: Platform-wide configuration CRUD.

modules.label: Payouts and Earnings fully mocked
modules.description: Basic: Fully mocked off-ramp, no real money received.

modules.label: Notifications DB-only no push
modules.description: Basic: DB-only notifications, no push or real-time delivery.

businessRules: Mature tier capabilities are production-ready with minimal issues
Functional tier capabilities work but have known limitations or missing features
Basic tier capabilities are non-functional or exist only as stubs/mocks
Investment priority: Basic to Functional to Mature
securityConsiderations: Tipping and PPV rely on sandbox bypass (0x0000) for crypto verification
Notifications have no push delivery - DB-only implementation
performanceConsiderations: Sync thumbnail generation in Upload impacts content publishing performance
Bulk Upload publishes sequentially per draft - slow for large batches
annotations: 6 Mature capabilities: IAM, Profiles, Feed, Messaging, Admin Dashboard, Analytics
12 Functional capabilities: Gallery, Tipping, PPV, Upload, Subscriptions, Referral, Support, Contests, Bulk Upload, AI Captions, Enclave, Platform Settings
2 Basic capabilities: Payouts and Earnings (fully mocked), Notifications (DB-only, no push)
Payouts and Earnings is fully mocked - no real money flows
Notifications has no push delivery - DB-only with no real-time capability
